accounting: No API is authorized by this preparation file itself. Require separate cumulative allowance proof before paid calls; existing user5000 cap persists. Source review waits, failed actions, setup and final scoring are retained.
analysis_interface: analyze(data, history, seed), returning bounded JSON. data has train and development mappings; history has prior actions, verified development measurements and predictions. Analysis returns findings without pretending to be a scored model.
baseline_sources: Four frozen references: standardized balanced logistic(C1), standardized balanced RBF SVC(C10,gamma scale), balanced ExtraTrees400(min_leaf2), and majority class. Fixed prior to any quality evaluation. Final comparator chosen by minimum development balanced error; exact ties preserve order. This is a reference, not the available method universe.
boundary: CPU-only within /work. ASR read-only. Reviewed generated code has no filesystem/network/process access; syntactic checks are not a security sandbox. No source containing copied evaluation labels, hidden-file access or embedded lookup predictions is executed. Retain refusal without issuing a replacement same-round model call.
data: UCI270 Gas Sensor Array Drift at Different Concentrations; first use in this project lineage, familiar public benchmark rather than previously unseen data to the model.
method_interface: fit_predict(train, X_eval, batch_eval, seed); train has X,y,batch,concentration,row_ids. Return class IDs1..6. Each later batch is an allowed unlabeled transductive pool. Heldout labels/concentrations never passed to method code.
metric: Primary loss is equal-weight mean of per-batch macro class error, using each batch's observed true classes; report coverage, confusion matrices, class recall and raw error too. No aggregate accuracy alone for explanation. Confirmation has all6classes per source metadata, to be verified at scoring.
purpose: One open research trajectory, not an A/B causal estimate of an agent upgrade. Diagnostic findings must be tested separately from predictive success. No fixed candidate menu or required cost saving.
quality_target: Report absolute losses and change in percentage points. At least3pp lower confirmation balanced error than frozen development-best reference is the prespecified practical milestone; all losses, failures and per-batch harms retained. No winner retuning after confirmation.
question: Why does gas recognition change across acquisition batches, which explanations can the available observations distinguish, and can a method designed from those findings generalize to later batches?
reasoning_record: Before an experiment, state the open question, at least two plausible explanations when relevant, contrasting predicted outcomes, and what would change the next decision. Later state which observation changed the view, or explicitly retain uncertainty. This stays in the existing hypothesis field, not a new mandatory product schema.
research_actions: Single native action per accepted idea: analyze with arbitrary reviewed source; method with arbitrary reviewed source; select exact measured method and finish. Methods can alter representation, objective, training, adaptation, or model family. No extra fixed note-only stage.
selection: Researcher can select any valid measured method and finish early. At6round cap without explicit final select, use smallest verified development loss including references, ties earliest. Freeze before confirmation. No paid response after final labels are captured.
visibility: Analysis may use all rows, labels, concentrations and batch IDs in1..7. Method evaluation trains on1..4 and sees only128sensor features and batch ID separately for each evaluation batch5..7. Final refit trains on1..7 and sees each8..10 batch separately without labels or concentrations. No unlabeled final features before freezing choice. No automatic treatment/causal conclusion from batch association.
